test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: During his entire school life, John’s average marks in science were 80% and his average marks in mathematics were 90%. If his combined average marks in science and mathematics were 84%, while the total maximum marks in science were 54,000, what were the total maximum marks in mathematics?
solution: Given: Average marks in science = 80% Average marks in mathematics = 90% Whole average = 84% Marks Obtained in science were 54,000. Concept used: Concept of Allegation.
